title: Support named setlist actions
prompt:
In lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart, allow callers to name the setlist in the pinned action and overflow tooltips, while preserving the existing tooltips when no name is supplied. Replace the exact lines:
  required String quick,
  required bool canEdit,
with:
  required String quick,
  required bool canEdit,
  String? setlistName,
Replace the exact line:
      tooltip: pinnedLabel,
with:
      tooltip: setlistName == null ? pinnedLabel : '$pinnedLabel: $setlistName',
Replace the exact lines:
    OverflowMenuAction(
      entries: [
with:
    OverflowMenuAction(
      tooltip: setlistName == null ? 'More' : 'More: $setlistName',
      entries: [
Run flutter test test/widgets/setlist_card_actions_test.dart and flutter test test/screens/bands/band_setlists_screen_test.dart. Update only assertions about the changed UI if necessary. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart && flutter test test/widgets/setlist_card_actions_test.dart && flutter test test/screens/bands/band_setlists_screen_test.dart

        return buildSetlistActions(
          quick: quick,
